var const.description: var const – can be re-assigned, but not edited

var var.description: var var – can be re-assigned and edited

lifetime.description: declaration with a lifetime (lines, 20s, Infinity, -1 for hoisting)

async function.description: async function – takes turns running lines with other async functions

if not.description: if not – the not operator is a semicolon

when.description: when – runs each time a variable in the condition mutates

new.description: the one instance of a class

debug.description: print debug info about this line

delete.description: delete a value or a keyword

reverse.description: reverse the direction of your code

signal.description: signal split into a getter and a setter

export.description: export a name to a file

import.description: import a name that was exported to this file

interpolation.description: string interpolation – use your regional currency

await next.description: the next value of a variable – see into the future

previous.description: the previous value of a variable
